Edd Webster Football Analytics

A space for football analytics projects by Edd Webster, including a curated list of publicly available resources published by the football analytics community

👋 About This Repository and Author

The README of this repository is a resources guide of learning materials, data sources, libraries, papers, blogs, , etc., created by all those that have made contributions to the open source football analytics community. This GitHub repository and resources list is always a work in progress, with new resources added semi-regularly. If you like the repo, please feel free to give it a ⭐ (top right). Cheers!
